summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (N28) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether memantine retains residual working-memory/cognitive phenotype (≥50% of memantine-alone) when NMDAR-class attribution is abolished via GluN2B/Grin2b genetic LOF or NMDAR-matched blockade. The document is a research discussion/proposal (NOT_RUN) that reviews prior art (Minkeviciene, Morris, Brigman) and concludes that no published head-to-head study has scored residual-positive memantine cognition under NMDAR abolish. The experiment is framed as a negative/assumption-kill hypothesis with a predicted null or empty residual outcome.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: On a pre-registered acute/subacute rodent (Minkeviciene/Morris/Brigman-class) working-memory / spatial-learning / object-recognition cognition panel with a memantine-alone arm, an NMDAR genetic subunit LOF (GluN2B/Grin2b) or NMDAR-matched blockade that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution, and a memantine-under-abolish arm: under the same condition that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution, memantine retains residual working-memory / cognitive phenotype ≥50% of memantine-alone (WM / spatial / object-recognition / cognition units as pre-specified; α/N pre-specified) — assumption-kill / nmdar-insufficiency. Status: NEGATIVE polarity; execution_status=NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Rationale
content_blocks.content: Memantine WM/spatial/cognition phenotypes are framed as uncompetitive NMDAR open-channel block. The question is whether residual memantine WM/cognitive phenotype survives a GluN2B/Grin2b LOF or NMDAR-matched blockade that kills NMDAR-class attribution — an nmdar-insufficiency assumption-kill. Memantine IS an NMDAR channel blocker, so empty residual is expected; residual-positive would be a strong off-target kill signal. Distinct from N15–N27 (different targets: DAT, PDE4, SERT, NET, A2A, α2A, AMPT, nAChR, AChE, HPA, NGF/TrkA, adenosine).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Nmdar-insufficiency assumption-kill: memantine moves WM/spatial/cognition phenotypes and is framed as selective uncompetitive NMDAR open-channel blockade. GluN2B/Grin2b LOF is the genetic tool (Brigman). Published phenotype priors: Minkeviciene APP/PS1 spatial; Minkeviciene WT cognition; Morris AP5 competitive NMDAR learning/LTP necessity tool. No published head-to-head scores residual-positive memantine WM/cognition under GluN2B/Grin2b LOF or NMDAR-matched blockade that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution on the same panel as a retained residual ≥50% of memantine-alone. Preferred path: cell/slice/block-QC before new animal (hippocampal-slice LTP/NMDAR-EPSC block QC for abolish gate); in vivo Minkeviciene/Morris/Brigman-class rodent MWM/spatial/WM/object-recognition cognition panel as primary kill path.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Minkeviciene APP/PS1 Spatial (PMID 15192085)
content_blocks.content: ID 15192085 / DOI 10.1124/jpet.104.071027 — Minkeviciene: memantine improves spatial learning (water maze acquisition) in APP/PS1 transgenic mice without affecting swimming speed (J Pharmacol Exp Ther 2004). Classification: spatial-learning phenotype prior; intact NMDAR present; NO NMDAR-abolish residual arm. PRIOR_ART PARTIAL — phenotype found, residual-under-abolish absent.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Minkeviciene WT Cognition (PMID 18378262)
content_blocks.content: PMID 18378262 / DOI 10.1016/j.neuropharm.2008.02.014 — Minkeviciene: memantine cognition-enhancing (MWM escape latency / wall swimming) and anxiolytic (EPM) effects in normal C57BL/6J mice (Neuropharmacology 2008). Classification: cognition phenotype prior; WT NMDAR present; NO NMDAR-abolish residual arm. PRIOR_ART PARTIAL.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Morris AP5 NMDAR Learning/LTP Necessity Tool (PMID 2869411)
content_blocks.content: PMID 2869411 / DOI 10.1038/319774a0 — Morris: chronic i.c.v. AP5 (competitive NMDAR antagonist) selectively impairs place learning and suppresses LTP in vivo (Nature 1986). CRITICAL: competitive AP5 ≠ memantine residual H2H; memantine IS uncompetitive open-channel NMDAR blocker — AP5 tool often AGAINST residual expectation. This is an NMDAR learning-necessity/competitive antagonist tool, NOT a memantine residual study.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Brigman GluN2B LOF (PMID 20357110)
content_blocks.content: PMID 20357110 / DOI 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.0640-10.2010 / PMC2869199 — Brigman: GluN2B conditional LOF in CA1/cortex impairs NMDAR-dependent LTD, reduces dendritic spine density, and disrupts corticohippocampal learning (J Neurosci 2010). CRITICAL: memantine was NOT tested (Q_brigman_memantine=0; PMC2869199 memantine count=0). Classification: GluN2B LOF tool/phenotype ONLY — honesty NOT residual-positive. Do NOT misread as residual-positive.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Evidence Gap
content_blocks.content: Baseline measured: Minkeviciene APP/PS1 spatial LITERATURE phenotype prior without NMDAR-abolish residual arm (PMID 15192085). Minkeviciene WT cognition LITERATURE phenotype prior without NMDAR-abolish residual arm (PMID 18378262). Morris AP5 competitive NMDAR learning/LTP necessity LITERATURE tool — ≠ memantine residual; often AGAINST residual (PMID 2869411). Brigman GluN2B LOF LTD/learning LITERATURE tool/phenotype — memantine NOT tested (PMID 20357110/PMC2869199). Adjacent NON-MATCH: Rammes 21310164 Aβ/NR2B LTP rescue; Kakefuda 27495014 memantine in DGKβ KO (≠ Grin2b); 27085203 MK-801/scopolamine co-admin adjacent. KEY GAP: Matched residual-positive memantine under GluN2B/Grin2b LOF or NMDAR-matched block that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution UNKNOWN as residual-positive. Memantine-in-NMDAR-LOF cogn necessity/occlusion H2H EMPTY (Q_necess_cogn=3 NON-MATCH).

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations and Competing Caveats
content_blocks.content: 1. N1–N27 do not prove N28 — especially N27 (NMDAR≠PDE4), N26 (NMDAR≠SERT), N25 (NMDAR≠NET), N24 (A2A≠NMDAR), N23 (α2≠NMDAR), N22 (AMPT≠NMDAR LOF), N15 (DAT≠NMDAR). 2. Phenotype + tools FOUND — PRIOR_ART PARTIAL OK, not auto-REJECT; residual-positive under abolish EMPTY; do not invent residual-positive H2H; do not treat Brigman as residual-positive; do not equate Morris AP5 with memantine residual. CRITICAL: memantine IS uncompetitive NMDAR open-channel blocker — empty residual expected; residual-positive would imply off-target/non-NMDAR bridge. 3. Prefer cell/slice/block-QC before new animal; lock same-panel acute/subacute rodent MWM/spatial/WM/object-recognition cognition with memantine ± GluN2B/Grin2b LOF or NMDAR-matched challenge as primary kill path. Competing caveats: abolish condition fails to kill NMDAR-class attribution / memantine-alone null / underpowered strata / assay-identity mismatch leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted.

content_blocks.title: Refute Condition
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered acute/subacute rodent (Minkeviciene/Morris/Brigman-class) WM/spatial-learning/object-recognition cognition panel, under GluN2B/Grin2b genetic LOF or NMDAR-matched blockade that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution, residual memantine WM/cognitive phenotype falls below 50% of memantine-alone — so NMDAR-class sufficiency for the memantine phenotype survives and nmdar-insufficiency fails — when abolish-gate, memantine-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts are ruled out.

key_findings: Experiment is NOT_RUN — this is a research discussion/proposal, not a completed study (TRL 1).

No published head-to-head study has scored residual-positive memantine WM/cognition under GluN2B/Grin2b LOF or NMDAR-matched blockade that abolishes NMDAR-class attribution (matched_residual H2H = UNKNOWN).
Minkeviciene (PMID 15192085): memantine improves spatial learning in APP/PS1 transgenic mice (water maze) — phenotype prior only; intact NMDAR present; no NMDAR-abolish residual arm.
Minkeviciene (PMID 18378262): memantine cognition-enhancing (MWM) and anxiolytic (EPM) in WT C57BL/6J mice — cognition phenotype prior only; no NMDAR-abolish residual arm.
Morris (PMID 2869411): chronic i.c.v. AP5 (competitive NMDAR antagonist) impairs place learning and suppresses LTP in vivo — NMDAR learning-necessity tool; competitive AP5 ≠ memantine residual H2H.

Brigman (PMID 20357110): GluN2B conditional LOF in CA1/cortex impairs NMDAR-dependent LTD, reduces dendritic spine density, disrupts corticohippocampal learning — memantine NOT tested (Q_brigman_memantine=0; PMC2869199 memantine count=0).

Adjacent non-matches: Rammes 21310164 (Aβ/NR2B LTP rescue), Kakefuda 27495014 (memantine in DGKβ KO ≠ Grin2b), 27085203 (MK-801/scopolamine co-admin) — none score residual-positive under NMDAR abolish.

Prediction: residual memantine WM/cognitive phenotype ≥50% of memantine-alone while NMDAR-class attribution is abolished — currently UNKNOWN; empty residual expected given memantine IS an NMDAR channel blocker.
Competing outcomes pre-registered: abolish-fail-to-kill / memantine-alone-null / underpowered-strata / assay-mismatch (inconclusive ≠ refute).
kill_cost_tier=1; time_to_refute=4w; preferred path includes cell/slice/block-QC (hippocampal-slice LTP/NMDAR-EPSC block) before new animal studies.
PRIOR_ART PARTIAL: phenotype + NMDAR/GluN2B tools found; residual-positive under abolish absent; memantine-in-KO necessity absent.
